about: One input of each shape, each named in its source, with one correlation.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 2
model: tiny
title: Four shapes
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  u_in:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: dimensionless
    distribution: {uniform: {minimum: 1.0, maximum: 3.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "uniform: the bounds are all that is known"}

  t_in:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: dimensionless
    distribution: {triangular: {minimum: 1.0, likely: 2.0, maximum: 5.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "triangular: least, likely, most"}

  l_in:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: dimensionless
    distribution: {lognormal: {p10: 1.1, p90: 1.9}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "lognormal: it compounds"}

  n_in:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: dimensionless
    distribution: {normal: {mean: 10.0, sd: 2.0}}
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "normal: symmetric error"}

  product:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: u_in * t_in * l_in * n_in

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - product

correlations:
  - {a: u_in, b: l_in, rho: 0.6, because: "stated for this case"}
